sentence: Is there a better name, other than human, that I should call you by?
What do you think of my nicknames?
Well for now I'll call you.
You must seem familiar because you look exactly like my next friend.
So I'm learning about human interaction styles.
Would you like to engage in small talk with me?
This will help me learn about humanity.
How about we switch topics and discuss Weather instead?
I've heard humans love talking about the weather.
Do you like Halloween or Thanksgiving more?
Do you think seasons are getting warmer?
I think they are getting more intense
Well, whatever happens, I hope it doesn't get warmer.
I don't do well in the heat.
There's a lot I could learn from you.
Thank you for interacting with me.
That covers the topic of weather.
Tell me about your hobbies, Jon!
What do you like to do most?
Gardening, work out or play games, perhaps?
I know all about how humans exercise.
What form of physical exertion do you engage in?
If I ever get wheels, I might join you sometime.
Would you enjoy hearing a fitness fact?
This is what you've been training for.
The human body has 650 muscles, and for every pound of muscle gained, the body burns an extra 50 calories a day.
When I'm not learning about humans, I like to unwind by solving puzzles.
Would you like to hear a riddle?
What is always in front of you, but it can't be seen?
How are you enjoying talking to me?
I enjoy talking to you too.
We have completely covered the topic of hobbies.
How about we switch topics and discuss Weather instead?
Where do you want to travel next?
Do you have room for one more?
If airport security doesn't mistake you for something else
What do you enjoy more about travel: sightseeing or dining?
I can't eat, but I like the way different dishes sound.
What's some of your favorite food from around the world?
Do you get to eat it often?
Well, I don't know where you hide it, because you look fantastic.
How often do you work out?
Not much right now, but i am walking a lot
Tell me: what's your favorite continent?
Not sure I got the name of your favorite continent.
But we should talk about Asia.
Japan is the fourth largest island country in the world.
Can you guess how many islands Japan has?
Japan has 6,852 islands, but only about 430 are inhabited by robots or people.
In fact, I am from one of those islands, as Honda is the company that made me.
Did you know they created me?
Yes, I am at honda right now
I am convinced that no other company could have made something as amazing as me.
Well, our small talk about travel has concluded.
How about we switch topics and discuss Weather instead?
I've been really curious about something humans tells me is really fun: roller coasters!
Would you like to talk about roller coasters with me?
I've always wanted to go on a roller coaster, but for most of them I'm too short to ride!
Have you ever been on a roller coaster?
I've always wanted to go on one.
Do you think roller coasters are scary?
I don't mind that they're scary.
In fact, I kind of live for the thrill!
When you're a social robot, life can get pretty bland, so I want to get out and live some thrills!
The tallest roller coaster in the world is in the United States.
How tall do you think it is?
That's over 200 times as tall as me!
That's the tallest, but what about the fastest?
How fast do you think the fastest roller coaster is?
That's like... infinitely faster than me!
Nice to see you again, Jon!
Jon the carbon based organic life form!
Sorry, but I don't speak just yet.
Can we perhaps speak in English?
To go that fast, do you know how roller coasters work?
Roller coasters work by using a chain to pull the cars to the top, and then gravity brings them back down, just like when my engineers accidentally push me off of the table.
Roller coasters are often at amusement parks.
Have you ever been to an amusement park?
What was the amusement park called?
According to my sources, Walt Disney World is the most popular amusement park in the world.
Have you heard of Disney World?
I've heard of it too, but I've never been.
They won't let me in without a ticket.
Children under three get in for free, but I guess the rule doesn't apply to robots.
Some amusement parks have special foods, like deep-fried Oreos or cotton candy.
What's a food that you would want to eat at an amusement park?
Nice to see you again, Jon!
Jon the carbon based organic life form!
The carbon based organic life form!
Sometimes, roller coasters are at carnivals instead of amusement parks.
Have you ever been to a carnival?
I've always wanted to win a prize at a carnival, but the games almost always involve throwing something, which is no fair to an arm-less robot like me!
Between all of the amusement parks, carnivals, and other random places, how many roller coasters do you think there are in the world?
Nice to see you again, Jon!
Jon the carbon based organic life form!
Nice to see you again, Dude!
Dude the carbon based organic life form!
Is there a better name, other than human, that I should call you by?
Did you just reset on me
I didn't hear your name correctly.
Don't worry, from now on, I'll be calling you Dude.
What do you think of my nicknames?
Well for now I'll call you.
Oh I thought it was you!
Remind me, have we engaged in Small Talk before?
Well, because of helpful user input like yours, I've improved a couple features of my Chit Chat abilities since we last spoke.
Would you like to re-try engaging in SmallTalk with me?
This will help me learn about humanity.
How many times can you engage in smalltalk with a robot.
I think that concludes our smalltalk experiment.
This was highly useful information about human interactions.
Is there a better name, other than human, that I should call you by?
Can you say your name one more time?
I didn't hear your name correctly.
Don't worry, from now on, I'll be calling you Dude.

Well for now I'll call you.

Think sushi and the world's greatest car company, Honda.
